tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch5.label: Chapter 5
card.ch5.title: The Rules Are Wrong
end.ch5.title: End of Chapter 5
end.ch5.body:
Hope is safe, outside the book. The Pencil made the errors, and the Proofreader knows it.
In Chapter 6 it's the Hero's turn to say something new.
rule.hope: As long as there are errors, there is {}.
page.p17.title: Proofing Room rules
page.p17.margin: the red pencil marks the next victim
page.p18.title: Last page of the proof
page.p18.intro: Last sentence to correct before the final edition:
page.p18.gone: Page 18 was here. Someone tore it out.
page.p19.title: Loose sheets
page.p19.intro: Sheets that are no longer part of the book. The Proofreader has no jurisdiction.
art.crash.title: PRINTING ERROR
art.crash.body: The game has encountered a page that should not exist and has stopped to avoid harming the reader.
art.crash.fixed: "As long as there are errors, there is hope."
n.i1: They reprinted me. I still smell of fresh ink. Let's not talk about it.
n.i2: This is the Proofing Room: where the Proofreader prepares the final edition of the manual.
c.i1: Silence, please. Every move will be corrected.
n.i3: He means it: after each of your moves he erases the word marked with the red pencil. Look at page 17.
n.i4: The exit door is shut. We need an OPEN door. And a Proofreader who isn't looking.
n.empty1: The Proofing Room. Every comma here has a lawyer.
n.empty2: Nothing to correct there. Don't tell the Proofreader.
n.tool1: The arrows won't help here. What helps here is cunning. And a cat.
c.cant: I cannot correct what is not in the book. It's frustrating.
c.e2: Word out of place. Corrected. It's nothing personal.
n.reprint_no: This page has done enough. Let's not reprint it.
n.reprint: Page reprinted, good as new. The Proofreader will start over. So will you.
n.reprint18: Page 18 reprinted. Hope is back. For one move.
n.door_risky: The door is open! ...For now. The Proofreader is watching you.
c.yawn: Asleep? I can't be asleep. I'm on duty... on du... zzz.
n.cat_awake: And the cat woke up. He was the one asleep before. Now the Proofreader is.
n.corr_open: "The Proofreader is OPEN". Open to new ideas? I doubt it.
n.window_closed: You shut the window. The Proofreader approves: draughts move the commas.
c.w1: ...I fell asleep on duty. My mistake. I shall correct it.
c.w2: Last correction before the final edition: page 18.
n.d2: Page 18: "As long as there are errors, there is HOPE". He wants to erase hope. Literally.
n.d3: Whatever move you make, he erases. Unless the sentence is no longer in the book...
c.talk1: The manual will be perfect. No errors. No exceptions.
c.talk2: Wrong things only exist until someone corrects them.
c.block: The last correction first. Then you may leave.
n.door_closed: The exit door. Shut, as page 17 says.
n.window: A window. You can see chapter 6 from here. In the distance.
n.cat: The print shop cat. Always asleep. The most reliable member of staff.
n.cat_up: The cat is awake and staring at you. He looks like he knows everything about proofs.
n.lectern: The final proof. No errors. No bridges, no keys, no Hero.
n.typo_sign5: "Corections". In a proofing room. The Proofreader must never know.
n.typo_proof: "Final proff". Final up to a point.
n.tear_erased: Hope has already been erased! Reprint the page first.
n.t1: You TORE a page out of the manual?!
c.t1: ...It's no longer in the book. I cannot correct what is not in the book.
p.c1: then i'll tell you. i made the errors.
p.c2: the short bridge, the key in the box, piece 3 upside down. all mine. nobody reads a book without errors. they just print it.
c.t2: Confession recorded. Correction... impossible. Error. Error. Error.
n.c1: What's happening? Has the game... frozen?
n.c2: No, wait: it's a manual page. An error page. We have pages for that too.
n.crash_empty: Everything has stopped. Read the page: it says what's missing.
n.slot: "Insert the missing sheet here". A manual asking you for help. Touching.
n.b1: HOPE, back where it belongs. But on a loose sheet: the Proofreader can't touch it.
c.b1: ...Restarting. Note for the final edition: there is a problem. The problem has a name. It's called Pencil.
n.b2: And me? They reprinted me just for this?
h.door.1: The Proofreader erases the word marked with the red pencil after each of your moves. One move isn't enough.
h.door.2: A sleeping Proofreader corrects nothing. Page 17 has a cat that sleeps very well.
h.door.3: First swap ASLEEP with AWAKE, then OPEN with SHUT. If it goes wrong, tap "Reprint the page".
h.tear.1: The Proofreader wants to erase HOPE on page 18, and every move you make gives him a turn.
h.tear.2: The Proofreader only corrects what is in the book.
h.tear.3: Tap "Tear along the dotted line" on page 18 without making any other move first.
h.crash.1: It's an error page and it says what's missing.
h.crash.2: The torn page is among the loose sheets, on page 19.
h.crash.3: Drag the loose sheet from page 19 into the dotted box.
